route_stop_data.position_units: route miles from each leg.from city toward leg.to city
route_stop_data.strategy: Offline curated dataset from public DOT rest-area pages, operator location pages, operator locator APIs, and development-time map review. Runtime play never calls external route or amenity services.
route_stop_data.license_notes: OpenStreetMap-derived future imports require ODbL attribution/share-alike review. Current route data keeps source notes per stop and favors public agency/operator pages.

ramp_length_bake.measure: derived from OpenStreetMap geometry: summed node-to-node distance along this exit's motorway_link way(s), from the gore node where the ramp leaves the motorway to the nearest node where it ends (a public road -- trunk to residential, not a service or private way -- or a dead end, else a motorway merge). Starts at the OSM diverge, at or near the gore, so any deceleration lane before it is not included; direction from the ramp's first edge against the leg. Screened: under 300 ft or over 1.5 mi dropped, not clamped. Local Geofabrik extract accessed 2026-06-23: https://www.openstreetmap.org/
ramp_length_bake.starts_at: the OSM node where the motorway_link way leaves the motorway way: at or near the gore (painted-gore start to physical nose, by mapper). The deceleration lane or taper lies before it and is not included.
ramp_length_bake.ends_at: the nearest surface-road node or dead end along the link ways, else the merge onto another motorway

position_screen.rule: derived: per leg, the median gap between each labelled exit's at_mi and the nearest same-ref OSM junction node on the leg's own polyline. Wider than the 1200 m far-end search radius, an exit not pinned to its own junction is not judged: it keeps its saved control and far end and gets no length or terminal. The fix is re-deriving the leg's interchange mileage, not this bake.

stop_approach_bake.source: derived: routed over the local OpenStreetMap extract from this exit's ramp terminal node (read) to the stop's read coordinates; per-street limit, controls and driveway as in facility_approaches.json generated.street_sources
